title: Abnormal expression of Kruppel-like transcription factors and their potential values in lung cancer.
authors: Shi, Yang; Yao, Min; Shen, Shuijie; Wang, Li; Yao, Dengfu
one_liner_zh: 综述KLF转录因子在肺癌中的异常表达及潜在临床价值，仅提及一个基于序列的XGBoost分类模型，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作机制与三维结构建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Lung cancer still is one of the most common malignancy tumors in the world. However, the mechanisms of its occurrence and development have not been fully elucidated. Zinc finger protein family (ZNFs) is the largest transcription factor family in human genome. Recently, the more and more basic and clinical evidences have confirmed that ZNFs/Kruppel-like factors (KLFs) refer to a group of conserved zinc finger-containing transcription factors that are involved in lung cancer progression, with the functions of promotion, inhibition, dual roles and unknown classifications. Based on the recent literature, some of the oncogenic KLFs are promising molecular biomarkers for diagnosis, prognosis or therapeutic targets of lung cancer. Interestingly, a novel computational approach has been proposed by using machine learning on features calculated from primary sequences, the XGBoost-based model with accuracy of 96.4 % is efficient in identifying KLF proteins. This paper reviews the recent some progresses of the oncogenic KLFs with their potential values for diagnosis, prognosis and molecular target in lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 肺癌仍是全球最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，然而其发生发展的机制尚未完全阐明。锌指蛋白家族（ZNFs）是人类基因组中最大的转录因子家族。近年来，越来越多的基础和临床证据证实，ZNFs/Krüppel样因子（KLFs）是一组含有保守锌指结构的转录因子，参与肺癌进展，具有促进、抑制、双重作用及未知分类等功能。基于近期文献，部分致癌性KLFs有望成为肺癌诊断、预后或治疗靶点的分子生物标志物。有趣的是，一种新型计算方法已被提出，通过机器学习对从初级序列计算的特征进行分析，基于XGBoost的模型准确率达96.4%，能有效识别KLF蛋白。本文综述了致癌性KLFs在肺癌诊断、预后及分子靶向方面的近期研究进展及其潜在价值。
